note: P4288 (Pro 26:26) — though hatred be covered with deception, wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

dims.v: concealed enmity — the hatred masked with deception for a time
the hatred that is covered over with deception — enmity hidden behind guile, but only for a time, until it is dragged into the light
the wickedness that will be exposed (266281)
welded to the wickedness time will reveal
sinah (hatred) — 'though his HATRED be covered with deception' (26:26); malice can be masked for a while, but not forever. Hidden hatred is on borrowed time.
revelation — the hidden evil dragged into the assembly's light
the wickedness that, however long masked by deception, will at last be exposed in the public assembly — evil that cannot stay hidden forever
the hidden hatred it flows from (266278)
welded to the masked enmity it finally reveals

ra (evil/wickedness) — 'his WICKEDNESS will be exposed in the assembly' (26:26); the truth outs. Hidden malice is finally dragged into public light, unmasked before all. Concealment is only ever temporary (cf Luke 12:2).
